subject: Graduate Engineer application, Marc Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Graduate Engineer, precontracts
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Graduate Engineer role in the precontracts team, advertised on SEEK. Tender work means turning drawings, specifications and site information into documents and numbers other people rely on, and the documentation and costing side of engineering is what my diploma trained me in.

In my Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (Albright Institute, completed February 2026) I prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities, compared design options and wrote up the choice, kept risk registers, and produced design documentation for road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater work in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. Before that I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and field engineer on subdivision finishing works: inspections, quality checks, drawing reviews, procurement tracking and progress reports. Two years in technical support at Concentrix (2020 to 2022) taught me to explain technical problems in plain terms and keep accurate case notes.

To be plain about the ad's preferences: my bachelor degree is from 2019, so it is outside the two years the ad ideally wants, though my Australian qualification is from this year; and I have not worked on substation, transmission or renewable energy projects. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Brisbane.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk about the precontracts work and what the first year would look like.

screening_answers.question: Tell us about yourself, your degree and what led you to study engineering.
screening_answers.answer: [Marc to write the personal part: why you chose engineering.] Facts to include: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, Divine Word College of Legazpi, Philippines (2014 to 2019); site roles in the Philippines 2019 to 2020 (project-in-charge on a community hall renovation, field engineer on subdivision finishing works); Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, completed February 2026, covering road, earthworks, pavement and drainage design, cost estimates and bills of quantities, risk registers, AutoCAD and Civil 3D.

screening_answers.question: What interests you about this graduate role and about working with All Energy Contracting?
screening_answers.answer: Suggested, in Marc's words: the precontracts work (tender documentation, design documentation, estimates) is the documentation and costing side of engineering I practised in the diploma; the ad says AEC's Australian and New Zealand operations and pipeline are growing, and its place in the OCU Group means learning from specialist businesses. [Marc to add anything personal.]

checklist: Attach the two PDFs from this record (resume and cover letter).
Answer the two written questions using the suggested answers above, in your own words; add why you chose engineering.
Submit before 25 October 2026 (the ad expires early on 26 October AEST).
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "SEEK".
notes: Advert says degree 'completed within last 2 years ideally' (not a hard bar) and desirable site experience; the letter states the honest position.
